payload.reason: M2.7 Slice 1 satisfies the approved architecture: the 1,437-line legacy workspace has been decomposed into a root workspace view and eight focused partials, all below the mandatory 500-line ceiling, with the workspace mounted through <x-layouts.workspace-layout> and the reported UI implemented through existing CampusLynk component infrastructure. Slice 2 is appropriately separated from Slice 1 and is limited to the four statutory print templates plus dedicated feature coverage. The four reports must mount exclusively through <x-layouts.report-layout>, preserve the statutory structures identified during analysis, and reuse existing report/UI infrastructure rather than carrying forward legacy print CSS or duplicated markup. The reported working tree is dirty, so implementation may proceed only within the explicitly authorized Slice 2 scope and must not absorb unrelated changes. No control-plane, schema, model, or User.php changes are authorized by this approval.
